parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: The rotation lid is the top cover of the wooden storage box, made of wood with a rectangular shape and smooth surface.
parts.Functional_description: It functions as a movable cover that can be opened or closed to access or protect the contents of the box.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a hinge axis connecting it to the base body, allowing it to open and close smoothly.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container portion of the wooden box, forming the storage compartment.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the primary storage space to hold items securely when the lid is closed.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides structural support for the lid and stored contents.
